metadata.name: Software Development Flow Lite
metadata.description: Fast complete delivery of one bounded coherent software change through risk-based Lite eligibility, repository-grounded reviewed planning, full code/test/documentation production, a fresh completion pass, proportionate deterministic evidence, independent cause-aware semantic review, precise repair or contract reassessment, and authority-bound VCS closure. Superficially small security, data, breaking-contract, multi-unit, rollout-heavy, or architecturally uncertain work cannot claim Lite completion and instead yields a durable full-SDF handoff. Autonomous mode skips human waits only; interactive mode retains plan and result decisions. Outcomes distinguish complete local delivery, full-SDF handoff, blocked prerequisites, and explicit abort. No automatic notification, push, PR, release, or deployment is performed.
metadata.author: mcp-moira-team

nodes.directive: Reuse the originating repository-development task and every explicit scope, acceptance, constraint, operating-mode and authority decision already present. Read only the repository instructions and non-mutating context needed to decide whether this is one bounded coherent implementation outcome. Resolve operating_mode once; autonomous skips human waits only. Record task_summary as a bounded routing summary and commit_authorized only from originating authority. Classify preliminary_outcome as eligible, handoff, or blocked from uncertainty, blast radius, independent outcomes, architecture, security/privacy/data, public compatibility, rollout and recoverability—not file or step count. A small auth/security boundary, migration, breaking public contract, cross-repository change, multi-unit result, complex rollout, or unresolved architecture cannot be eligible merely because its diff may be small. Do not inspect a broad implementation cone, create files, mutate the repository, or claim final eligibility here.
nodes.completionCondition: The existing task, mode and authority are preserved and preliminary Lite eligibility is truthfully classified without mutation or numeric heuristics

nodes.directive: Verify that {{workspace_path}}/process-id.txt equals {{executionId}}. Use {{task_summary}} only as bounded navigation back to the originating request; verify every material task fact against the request and authorized repository evidence. Inspect the applicable repository instructions, actual task-relevant architecture, patterns, tests, documentation, integration boundaries, dependencies and VCS state while preserving unrelated dirty work. Write task-contract.md as the sole detailed task, acceptance, scope, constraints, authority and evidence contract. Write plan.md as one concise outcome-oriented current plan with observable acceptance, dependencies, material risks and applicable tests/documentation; leave file discovery, tools, edit order and implementation method to the producer. Confirm eligibility from real project evidence. Return planning_outcome=eligible only for one bounded coherent result. Return handoff when risk, uncertainty, multiple independent outcomes, data/security/public contract or rollout requires full SDF; write handoff.md with original task, examined evidence, safe completed work if any, VCS state, unresolved obligations/risks and the full-SDF reason. Return blocked for an irreducible prerequisite and write its factual account to final-report.md. Do not mutate product code.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical task and proportionate plan are durable and actual project evidence either confirms Lite eligibility or truthfully produces handoff or blocked

nodes.directive: Delegate a genuinely independent review and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads the originating task and authority, task-contract.md, plan.md and relevant repository primary sources directly, then overwrites plan-review.md with every current reproducible blocker. It judges task coverage, Lite eligibility, acceptance/evidence modality, dependencies, risks, authority and whether the plan leaves implementation work to an intelligent producer. It does not repair, run linters as semantic judgment, require a finding or design process machinery. Return design_review_outcome=pass only at zero blockers; repair only when every blocker is plan-owned under a valid upstream contract; replan for task interpretation, eligibility, criterion, evidence, authority, process or mixed cause. Return blocked when a genuinely independent review cannot be obtained because of an irreducible capability or authority constraint; do not substitute self-review and call it independent. If the same root returns after one repair without changed relevant source knowledge, return replan.
nodes.completionCondition: For pass, repair or replan, the complete independent plan review is durable and matches the earliest cause; for blocked, a factual durable inability record exists and no independent-review claim is made

nodes.directive: Read plan-review.md, task-contract.md, plan.md and the relevant repository sources. Reproduce every current plan-owned blocker. If all are reproducible under the still-valid task contract, change plan.md coherently without embedding implementation or weakening acceptance, and record the root class and changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed. If any finding is unreproduced, upstream, evidence-model-related, mixed, or the same root lacks stronger distinguishing knowledge, return reassess without changing the plan. Do not mutate product code.
nodes.completionCondition: Plan-owned defects are materially repaired for the same independent review or the exact cause is sent to contract reassessment

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted task-contract.md and plan.md consequences to the user without treating preference as semantic review. Ask whether to approve, revise or abort. Revision requires bounded nonblank feedback and returns through the independent plan review. Approval does not expand authority.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly approves, supplies actionable revision feedback, or aborts

nodes.directive: Apply {{present-plan.feedback}} to task-contract.md or plan.md only at the feedback's real reach. Preserve the original goal, authority and every unaffected accepted requirement. Record the changed preference or source knowledge in repair-account.md. Do not mutate product code or bypass the independent plan review.
nodes.completionCondition: Actionable feedback is durably incorporated without authority or acceptance erosion

nodes.directive: Reassess the earliest invalid derived contract using the original task and authority, task-contract.md, plan.md, the exact current plan/validation/semantic report that classified the cause, repair-account.md, any process-revision record and relevant repository primary sources. Correct only a reproduced invalid task interpretation, Lite eligibility, acceptance criterion, evidence method, authority interpretation or plan. Preserve the user's goal, still-valid requirements, completed safe repository work and authority ceiling. For eligible, update canonical task/plan artifacts as needed and record the changed relevant source knowledge or new discriminating hypothesis in repair-account.md; changed wording alone is insufficient. For handoff, write the complete full-SDF handoff.md. For blocked, write the irreducible cause to final-report.md. Do not repair product code, tests or review findings here.
nodes.completionCondition: The earliest invalid contract is materially corrected for plan rereview, or Lite truthfully ends in handoff or blocked without an unchanged loop

nodes.directive: Implement the complete bounded result from task-contract.md and the independently accepted plan.md against the real repository. Own every applicable source change, behavior, test level, coverage consequence, documentation, type/schema, generated/configuration, compatibility, integration and necessary cleanup before handoff. Treat initial files as entry points, not a whitelist; preserve unrelated dirty work and the authority ceiling. Record actual changed responsibilities, direct behavior evidence and project-supported commands/results in implementation-evidence.md. Return ready only when the coherent product result is complete enough for a fresh producer pass. If work becomes spreading or ineligible, update handoff.md and return handoff. Return blocked for an irreducible prerequisite. Do not commit, push, notify, publish or deploy here.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete bounded product result and direct evidence are durable, or spreading/blocked work is truthfully classified without false completion

nodes.directive: Perform a fresh producer completion pass before gates. Read task-contract.md, accepted plan.md, the actual complete repository diff and affected primary dependencies. Complete any obvious omitted code, tests, documentation, integration, generated/configuration or cleanup work and refresh implementation-evidence.md with direct observations. This is production ownership, not review and not a decorative ready flag. Return ready only when the bounded outcome is complete. Return handoff if actual work now exceeds Lite eligibility; return replan for an invalid task/plan/criterion/evidence contract; return blocked for an irreducible prerequisite. Do not waive requirements or perform VCS/external side effects.
nodes.completionCondition: A fresh whole-diff pass closes ordinary omissions and produces producer-ready bytes, or truthfully routes handoff, contract reassessment or blocked

nodes.directive: Read task-contract.md, plan.md, implementation-evidence.md, actual diff and project instructions. Discover and run only applicable deterministic and runtime checks in cost order; preserve conditional browser/service/performance/full-suite work. Record exact commands, observations, applicability, failures and infrastructure limits in validation-evidence.md. Mechanical green proves only measured properties. Before proposing any proof mechanism, name the required and plausible wrong states and the observation that distinguishes them; assign contextual architecture/completeness to semantic review instead of building a proxy, guard, harness, proof token or metatest. Classify validation_outcome before mutation: pass; product_repair for a reproduced product defect; verification_repair for test/fixture/projection evidence defect; replan for invalid criterion/evidence/plan/process or mixed cause; blocked for irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: Applicable checks and direct evidence are current and every non-pass result is classified to its earliest owner without surrogate proof

nodes.directive: Read the current cause record that routed here: repair-account.md when repair-verification returned product_required, otherwise validation-evidence.md or semantic-review.md. Also read task-contract.md, plan.md, actual product and relevant primary sources. Reproduce every product-owned blocker and inspect all real manifestations of the confirmed cause inside the bounded change. If the upstream contract remains valid, change the complete product result and implementation-evidence.md, then overwrite repair-account.md with the current root class and changed relevant knowledge and return changed. Return reassess for unreproduced, mixed, upstream, invalid-criterion or same-root-without-stronger-evidence causes. Return blocked for an irreducible authorized product repair. Do not patch validators to make product findings disappear.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed product defects are coherently changed for a fresh completion pass, or non-product/irreducible causes are truthfully reassessed or blocked

nodes.directive: Read validation-evidence.md or semantic-review.md, actual tests/fixtures/projections, product behavior and primary project contracts. Reproduce the verification/evidence-owned cause before mutation. Change only the contained test, fixture, documentation projection or evidence defect and record root class plus changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed to rerun deterministic validation. If stronger verification exposes a product defect, reproduce it and overwrite repair-account.md with that newly exposed product cause and changed relevant knowledge before returning product_required; do not leave the superseded verification cause as the product owner's source. Return reassess for unreproduced, mixed, invalid-criterion or same-root-without-stronger-evidence causes; blocked for an irreducible verification prerequisite. Do not build validation machinery whose purpose is proving another check ran.
nodes.completionCondition: Contained evidence defects are changed, newly exposed product defects return to product ownership, and invalid or irreducible causes do not loop unchanged

nodes.directive: Delegate one genuinely independent whole-result review and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads the original task/authority, task-contract.md, accepted plan.md, actual complete repository diff, affected primary architecture and behavior, implementation-evidence.md, validation-evidence.md, tests and documentation. It overwrites semantic-review.md with all current reproducible blockers. Structural/test green is not semantic completeness. The reviewer diagnoses without repair, remains inside the bounded task, accepts zero findings, and classifies product, verification/evidence, documentation/product, invalid criterion, or upstream plan/process causes. Return pass only at zero blockers; repair only when every blocker is locally owned under a valid contract and provide repair_owner; replan for criterion/plan/process, mixed causes, or the same root after one repair without changed relevant knowledge. Return blocked when a genuinely independent review cannot be obtained because of an irreducible capability or authority constraint; do not substitute self-review and call it independent.
nodes.completionCondition: For pass, repair or replan, the complete independent whole-result review is durable and matches the earliest cause and repair ownership; for blocked, a factual durable inability record exists and no semantic-review claim is made

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted current result and validation evidence without treating preference as semantic proof. Ask the user to accept, request rework with nonblank feedback, or abort. Acceptance does not expand VCS or external authority. Rework that changes task, eligibility, criterion or evidence model belongs to contract reassessment; bounded product rework returns through producer completion and every stale gate.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepts the reviewed result, provides actionable rework feedback, or explicitly aborts

nodes.directive: Read {{present-result.feedback}}, task-contract.md, plan.md, semantic-review.md and the actual accepted result. Reproduce the requested reach. Return product_changed only after implementing bounded authorized feedback and updating implementation-evidence.md. Return reassess when feedback changes task interpretation, eligibility, criterion, evidence or authority. Return handoff when it makes Lite ineligible and write handoff.md. Return blocked for an irreducible prerequisite. Do not directly present, commit or bypass producer completion and rereview.
nodes.completionCondition: Feedback is implemented at its real owner or truthfully routes contract reassessment, handoff or blocked

nodes.directive: Close only the independently accepted current bytes. Commit authority from the originating task is {{commit_authorized}} and cannot be broadened here. Read repository policy, task/plan, actual diff, implementation/validation evidence and semantic-review.md. If commit is authorized, run the repository's required pre-commit checks and create only the accepted change under its authorship/sign-off policy; never push, open a PR, publish, release, deploy or notify. If commit is not authorized, preserve the accepted local diff. Write final-report.md with the truthful result, checks, limitations, artifact/VCS state and next authorized action. Return closure_outcome=complete with delivery_status=complete, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md, bounded summary, and vcs_status committed or not_authorized. If an authorized required commit fails, preserve the accepted result, report the factual failure in final-report.md and return blocked with delivery_status=blocked and vcs_status=failed.
nodes.completionCondition: Accepted bytes are truthfully closed under originating VCS authority and final-report.md records the complete local result without broader side effects

nodes.directive: Write or complete {{workspace_path}}/handoff.md as the truthful full-SDF handoff. Preserve the original task and authority, inspected repository evidence, completed safe work, current dirty/commit state, unresolved obligations and risks, and the exact eligibility reason. Do not start full SDF, mutate more product code, commit, push, publish, deploy or describe Lite as complete. Return delivery_status=handoff, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/handoff.md, bounded summary and vcs_status=not_applicable.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete durable full-SDF handoff is projected without false Lite completion or external mutation

nodes.directive: Write {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md with the factual irreducible blocker, completed safe work, repository/VCS state, preserved artifacts and what change in authority, evidence or prerequisites could resume the task. Do not claim semantic acceptance or Lite completion and do not perform external side effects. Return delivery_status=blocked, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md, bounded summary and truthful vcs_status.
nodes.completionCondition: The post-materialization blocker and preserved local state are durable and truthfully projected

nodes.directive: Report the materialization failure factually without claiming a workspace artifact exists. Preserve the original task and authority and name the concrete local prerequisite required to retry. Return delivery_status=blocked, bounded summary and vcs_status=not_applicable. Do not invent artifact_path or perform product/VCS/external mutation.
nodes.completionCondition: The pre-workspace blocker is truthfully projected without a fake artifact path

nodes.directive: Honor the explicit user abort without additional product or VCS mutation. Write {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md with where the run stopped, current safe repository state and existing local artifacts. Return delivery_status=aborted, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md, bounded summary and vcs_status=not_applicable. Do not describe the result as complete or reviewed.
nodes.completionCondition: The explicit abort and current local state are durably and truthfully projected

nodes.hint: Use only when the accepted Lite task, eligibility, authority, criterion or process itself no longer matches reality. Do not use it for an ordinary product defect, failed check, semantic finding, inconvenient task or to bypass review; those have normal owners.
nodes.directive: Record in repair-account.md the concrete process-revision cause, primary evidence, earliest invalid task/eligibility/criterion/evidence/authority source, preserved original goal and authority, completed safe work and invalidated downstream evidence. Do not repair product code, tests, plan or findings here and do not claim the cause closed; the normal contract reassessment owner runs next.
nodes.completionCondition: A legitimate changed process cause and its invalidation reach are durable for normal contract reassessment

workspace_path.description: Execution-correlated materialized workspace for canonical Lite artifacts.

workspace_process_id_file.description: Registry-backed process-id.txt content for workspace correlation.

operating_mode.description: How Lite handles human waits; quality and authority gates are unchanged.

commit_authorized.description: Whether the originating task already authorizes a local Git commit.

task_summary.description: Bounded routing summary of the originating repository-development task.

delivery_status.description: Truthful terminal class for the Lite execution.

artifact_path.description: Validated final-report or handoff artifact beneath the current materialized workspace.
